title: Listing Highlight: 41' Custom NNS Sea Scout 2007 | MISS CATHY
description: Explore the 2007 Custom NNS Sea Scout 41, a luxurious express cruiser featuring unique design, powerful performance, and exquisite craftsmanship.
html:
2007 Custom NNS Sea Scout 41 Express Cruiser: A Unique Maritime Experience

The 2007 NNS Sea Scout 41, affectionately known as MISS CATHY, is a one-of-a-kind express cruiser that offers a distinctive blend of craftsmanship and functionality. Handcrafted in Turkey by NNS Shipyard, this vessel was delivered to the U.S. in 2007 and stands out with its pistachio green hull and elegant teak decking. This express cruiser is designed for those who appreciate both style and performance on the water.

Overview of the 2007 NNS Sea Scout 41 Express Cruiser

MISS CATHY is a unique express cruiser that showcases the meticulous craftsmanship of NNS Shipyard. The yacht’s pistachio green hull and teak decking make it visually striking, while its spacious layout provides ample room for relaxation and entertainment. With a forward VIP full berth and a guest cabin to port, the yacht offers comfortable accommodations for extended journeys.

Engine Specifications and Performance Details

Powered by twin Volvo Penta D6-310D-B IPS 400 engines, MISS CATHY delivers a combined total of 620 horsepower. With only 300 engine hours, these engines promise reliability and efficiency. The yacht’s cruising speed of 28 knots ensures swift and smooth navigation, making it an ideal choice for both leisurely cruises and more adventurous outings.


Luxurious Interior and Accommodation Features

Inside, MISS CATHY offers a spacious salon with a well-equipped lower-level galley, perfect for preparing meals while at sea. The forward VIP full berth and port-side guest cabin provide comfortable sleeping arrangements for guests. The yacht is also equipped with new air conditioning and an electric head, ensuring a comfortable onboard experience regardless of the weather.

Advanced Electronics and Navigation Systems

The yacht is outfitted with a comprehensive suite of electronics, including radar, GPS, autopilot, and a navigation center, ensuring precise and safe navigation. Additional features such as a flat-screen TV and a VHF radio enhance the onboard experience, providing both entertainment and communication capabilities.

Exterior Design and Construction Techniques

The NNS Sea Scout 41 is constructed using the cold-molding technique, which combines mahogany with fiberglass for a strong yet lightweight hull. This method enhances the vessel’s durability and performance, allowing it to glide smoothly over the waves. The teak cockpit and sidedecks add a touch of elegance, while features like the cockpit shower and swimming ladder enhance functionality.

Summary and Contact Information for Purchase

The 2007 NNS Sea Scout 41 MISS CATHY is a remarkable vessel that combines unique design with practical features. Its powerful engines, spacious accommodations, and advanced navigation systems make it an excellent choice for discerning buyers.
